thread:
rohan: Heads-up from compliance review — a few small but noisy UI issues around the audit log export and the little 'KMS' chip. Folks keep misinterpreting it in exports and the console. CC @dina @sam

ellsworth: Saw the call notes. Two quick asks: make export headers human-readable for auditors, and don't use a terse 'KMS' token in CSVs. They parse by header name.

dina: Totally. Proposal: CSV headers become full labels (Key management, Retention period (days), Region (geo)). Keep the old short headers as aliases for 90 days behind a compatibility switch. We should surface that in the export modal.

sam: Backend: INFRA prefers not to change the payload shape without a deprecation plan. Adding new headers + keeping old ones for a while is the right path. I'll file infra ticket and include compatibility flag.

yasmin: From UX: in-table 'KMS' chip is too terse. Customers want to know provider and alias. Suggest expanding chip text to 'Customer-managed (KMS) — alias: <short>' with truncated alias and a hover to reveal full.

rohan: Good idea. Also, when alias is missing we currently render 'KMS' which feels like it's telling them something it isn't. If metadata missing show 'Customer-managed (KMS) — metadata unavailable' and include a small link 'Check KMS' to open the details panel.

a11y-bot: Accessibility note: chips must have aria-labels (e.g., "Key management: Customer-managed key, alias foo") and be focusable. Hover-only tooltips are inaccessible — ensure keyboard focus triggers them too. Also color contrast on the chip background/text must meet 4.5:1 for small text.

dina: For the export modal copy: "Exports include human-readable headers for compliance. Deprecated short headers (e.g., 'kms') are included for compatibility through 2026-09-01." Add a checkbox "Include deprecated headers" (default on) and a short code sample. Thoughts?

sam: Add deprecation notice to docs and an API version header so integrators can programmatically detect new format. INFRA ticket INFRA-1415.

yasmin: Another small UX nit: when a user chooses a retention preset that is then overridden by org policy, show two labels: "Selected: 30 days" and "Effective: 90 days (enforced by org)" with a link to view policy. Use role="status" to announce the effective value change for screen readers.

a11y-bot: Confirming: dynamic messages should use aria-live/role=status and focus management must move to the confirmation button after changing settings. Also the region selector ordering should be org-default, recent, alphabetical — keyboard users expect that flow. Ensure Arrow keys keep menu open and move focus internally. File accessibility bug #4633.

ellsworth: Small export detail: add an 'encryption_details' column (alias|algorithm|rotated_at) so auditors can ingest rotation info without hitting the API. Size impact is minimal.

dina: I'll mock the table + export modal, include aria attributes and chips expanded copy. Planning to ship the UI changes behind a feature flag while infra adds the CSV headers. PR ETA 48hrs.

sam: Filing infra task now, linking to this thread and marking backwards compat.

rohan: Outcome summary: full CSV headers + compatibility aliases, expanded in-table key copy with fallback 'metadata unavailable', export checkbox + deprecation copy, 'encryption_details' column, retention selected vs effective labels, region ordering change, and a11y improvements (aria-live, focus, keyboard for tooltips). Thanks all — please add any objections now. :thumbsup:
